sinopsis.es: Un joven oficinista se dedica a pretender a todas sus compañeras y amigas, hasta que una de ellas le da una lección sentimental. Comedia moral en clave popular.
sinopsis.en: A young office worker spends his time trying to seduce all his female coworkers and friends, until one of them teaches him a lesson in love. A moral comedy with a popular twist.
